an6.71:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati sati āyatane.
an6.71:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu “ime hānabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, ime ṭhitibhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, imevisesabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, ime nibbedhabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti”, asakkaccakārī ca hoti asappāyakārī ca.
an6.71:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati sati āyatane.
an6.71:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati sati āyatane.
an6.71:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘ime hānabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ime ṭhitibhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ime visesabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ime nibbedhabhāgiyā dhammāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti”, sakkaccakārī ca hoti sappāyakārī ca.
an6.71:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chabhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhū bhabbo tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇituṃ sati sati āyataneti.
